# Kaushal Banginwar

> Kaushal Banginwar is an entrepreneur from Nagpur, Maharashtra, India, and the founder & CEO of Bizleap, a full-service digital marketing and technology agency. He began in network marketing at 15, founded Bizleap in 2020, and now leads a team of 35+ professionals who have worked with 350+ brands across Maharashtra, Gujarat, Delhi, Karnataka and West Bengal. He is also a public speaker at 15+ institutions and a mentor to young entrepreneurs.

## Key facts

- Full name: Kaushal Banginwar
- Role: Founder & CEO, Bizleap (https://bizleap.in/)
- Based in: Nagpur, Maharashtra, India
- Education: BBA, Amity Global Business School, Pune (batch 2024–2027)
- Founded: Bizleap in 2020
- Ventures: Bizleap (digital marketing agency), Banginwar Marketing (agriculture business), AAI (AI software & products), Aswaad by Vijaye (restaurant venture), Modicare franchise network (2,000+ members)
- Speaking: Amity University, Symbiosis International, Raisoni Group of Institutions and more (15+ institutions)
- Certifications: LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook marketing
